[[File:MystifyingHoop.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A schematic of Magwit's Mystifying Hoop highlighting the frame's Power Transmitter Receptors.]]
'''Power Transmitter Receptors''' were components that were used in [[Magwit's Mystifying Hoop]]. Thirty Receptors were embedded into the inner ring of the hoop, each with a corresponding replaceable [[matter transmitter]] that allowed the frame to [[Teleporter|teleport]] individuals and objects through it.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
